title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: What did you see?
hook: Try asking one question after the next mistake.
intro: A player shoots from a bad angle.
statement: Kids learn to read the game when you ask what they noticed.
q1: Do you ask what they saw before you say anything —
q2: or point it out quickly and move on?
q3: How often do they already know?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But players think more
t2: when you ask them to look first.
cta: Coaches — do you ask what they saw?
ctaLines: What did you see? Where was the space? Who was open?
ctaPrompt: Share your teaching habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Try asking one question after the next mistake.
A player shoots from a bad angle. A teammate was wide open.
Kids learn to read the game when you ask what they noticed.
Ask what they saw or point it out. Every team is different.
Do you ask what they saw? Share your habit in the comments.
